claims.text: Why can nesting hollow shapes save envelope space without removing material?
claims.source: Transfer prompt, grounded by this lesson's mechanism and limitations.

claims.text: Nesting shares the hollow: 8 + 3 × 2 = 14 cm. Kept separate, each pocket needs its own 8 cm: 4 × 8 = 32 cm. No material was removed. Real elastic and seams change the numbers.

recall.question: A corner pocket is 8 cm tall on its own, and each extra corner nested inside adds 2 cm. How tall are 4 corners nested, against 4 kept separate?
recall.why: Nesting shares the hollow: 8 + 3 × 2 = 14 cm. Kept separate, each pocket needs its own 8 cm: 4 × 8 = 32 cm. No material was removed. Real elastic and seams change the numbers.
